task: Independent wave2 discovery acceptance, not alpha or beta
method: Reviewed both source-checked packets; selectively browsed primary sources for uncertain affiliates, sponsors and geography. Unreopened evidence is explicitly attributed to source workers. Registry precision/EIN is not required at discovery, but a multi-agency umbrella or sponsored initiative without resolved organization-level recipient scope is held. Known adverse legal-status evidence is held at parent direction; ordinary missing EIN alone is not.
threshold: Identifiable real operating organization + plausible health mechanism + explicit in-scope activity. Sponsored programs require resolved organization-level recipient scope; cannot be silently counted as organizations. No ranking, cost-effectiveness, unrestricted-gift additionality, tax status or donation recommendation accepted.
globalDeduplicationLimit: Initial20 name exclusion checked by source workers; no comprehensive registry/alias deduplication against all legacy SF reports. Existing report overlap is reuse, not new research. PAF/PAN merger family already known in initial40; no PAF or PAN candidate is in this wave.

timeAccounting.basis: Actual individually started/stopped organization-specific source checks only. General packet review, synthesis, coordination and file authoring not apportioned.
timeAccounting.sourceWorkerSessions: References only; not imported or added to this audit's measured seconds.
